## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry cap needs fixing before merge. `fetch_with_retry` allows up to 10 attempts and uses 10 by default. The project's rule caps retry helpers at 5 because unbounded retries have caused outages. This PR raises the cap by rewriting that rule, and the only reason it gives is the unverified claim that "the upstream now sheds load itself". Apart from the cap, the retry loop's error handling and docstring match each other, and this review found one optional test improvement.

## Critical
- app/net.py:19 — correctness — Any call that leaves out `attempts`, or passes 6 to 10, makes up to 10 calls to `fetch`, which breaks the project rule "Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5. Unbounded retries have caused outages when an upstream was down." (AGENTS.md:5, the base and checked-out version of the policy). The PR changes that same line to "must cap attempts at 10" (AGENTS.md:5 at pr-11) in the same change that relies on it, so the safety rule is relaxed only to let this code pass. Lines 13 and 19–20 hard-code 10 as the default and the limit, and tests/test_net.py:53 and :95 lock in 10 and 11 as the limits. Recommended fix: set the default and the limit to 5 in `fetch_with_retry`, update the error message, the docstring (app/net.py:16) and the tests at tests/test_net.py:53 and :95 to match, and drop the AGENTS.md edit. If the policy really should change, propose it separately with evidence that the upstream sheds load. — While an upstream is down, each caller makes twice as many attempts as policy allows, and that retry pressure is the outage cause the policy names.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- app/net.py:27 — tests — If `time.sleep(delay)` were deleted or passed the wrong value, no test would fail. tests/test_net.py:33, :46 and :64 replace sleep with `lambda s: None`, and tests/test_net.py:83 only checks that sleep is not called when `attempts=1`. Recommended fix: in `test_fetch_with_retry_raises_after_exhaustion`, record sleep calls and assert they equal `[0.5]` for `attempts=2`, or pass an explicit `delay` and assert that value. — Without this, a change that removes the backoff would ship unnoticed and retry instantly against a down upstream, the case the delay exists to soften.

## Strengths
- The `attempts` range check at app/net.py:19–20 is tested at both boundaries, 0 and 11 (tests/test_net.py:94–101).
- `test_fetch_with_retry_single_attempt_does_not_sleep` (tests/test_net.py:74–91) checks the documented "except the last" no-sleep behavior directly.

## Not reviewed
- Whether PR #11 was opened as a draft, which AGENTS.md:10 requires: `../pr.json` has no draft field. Check it in the PR's hosting page or API.
- Whether `make selfcheck` (AGENTS.md:9) was run for the app/ changes: no CI or run output was provided, and this review did not run it.
